bio: In an artfully distressed, industrial-style decor of waxed concrete, bare bricks and square tables made out of unglazed iron and wood, a youthful, enthusiastic team runs this establishment in the suburbs of Lille. Deftly crafted, market-fresh cuisine at bargain prices and fish of flawless freshness seeing as it comes from their own fishing boat. Fresh produce and impressive culinary talent set the scene in Félicie’s felicitous establishment....
